description:
Saraiki LLM Benchmark v1.0
	

A seven-task benchmark for evaluating language models in Saraiki (Jataki/Multani, Shahmukhi script).

Evaluation only. Do not train on this dataset.

Multiple-choice and math configs include a small dev split that serves as the few-shot examples (5 shots, or 8 for math). instruction_following and truthfulness_safety are 0-shot and have only a test split.
